auth.description: Trello API key, identifying the Power-Up registration a call is made through. Travels as the `key` query parameter on every request, always together with the token; neither authenticates a call alone
auth.name: trello.key
auth.subject: unstated

auth.description: Trello API token, granting access to one member's account. Travels as the `token` query parameter on every request, always together with the key; a token is only valid against the key it was minted for
auth.name: trello.token
auth.subject: unstated

config.help: Generate one at trello.com/power-ups/admin: open (or create) a Power-Up, then the API Key tab. Do this first — the token below is minted against this key and only works with it
config.label: Trello API key
config.name: api_key

config.help: From the same API Key page, follow the manual token link and click Allow. The token grants access to everything your Trello account can see, so treat it as a password
config.label: Trello API token
config.name: api_token

description: Trello boards and cards: list the boards a token can see, read a board and its lists, read a list's cards, create a card, and archive one. Authenticates every request with an API key and a token together, both in the query string

operations.description: List every board the token's own member can see, newest activity first. Takes no argument — `me` resolves to whoever the token belongs to. Also this connector's `verify`: a bounded read that runs unattended and needs nothing configured beyond the credential pair

closed.description: Whether the board is archived. An archived board still reads

dateLastActivity.description: When anything on the board last changed

id.description: The board's id — what trello-board-get and trello-board-lists address it by

idMemberCreator.description: The member who created the board

idOrganization.description: The Workspace this board belongs to, or null for a personal board

labelNames.description: The board's six label colours mapped to the names it gives them

prefs.description: Board settings — visibility, voting, card covers, background and more. Left untyped rather than enumerated in full; see Trello's own Board object reference

shortLink.description: The short id appearing in a board URL

subscribed.description: Whether the token's member follows this board

url.description: The board's page — the link to give a human

operations.description: Get one board by id, with its settings and current state

params.description: The board's id, from trello-board-list's `id` — or the short id in a board's own URL, which Trello accepts here too
params.name: id

dateLastActivity.description: When anything on the board last changed

idMemberCreator.description: The member who created the board

idOrganization.description: The Workspace this board belongs to, or null for a personal board

labelNames.description: The board's six label colours mapped to the names it gives them

prefs.description: Board settings — visibility, voting, card covers, background and more. Left untyped rather than enumerated in full; see Trello's own Board object reference

shortLink.description: The short id appearing in a board URL

subscribed.description: Whether the token's member follows this board

url.description: The board's page — the link to give a human

operations.description: List the open lists (columns) on a board, left to right. Each carries the `id` trello-list-cards and trello-card-create take
List the open cards in one list, in board order. Archived cards are not returned

badges.description: Counts Trello renders on the card front — comments, attachments, checklist progress, due state. Left untyped rather than enumerated in full

dueComplete.description: Whether the due date has been ticked off

id.description: The card's id — what trello-card-archive addresses it by

idBoard.description: The board the card belongs to

idList.description: The list the card currently sits in

idMembers.description: The members assigned to the card, as ids. Identifies named people — read it for what the calling flow needs and do not persist it beyond that

idShort.description: The card's per-board number, as shown in its UI

labels.description: The card's labels, expanded. Left untyped rather than enumerated

name.description: The card's title, as it reads on the board

pos.description: The card's sort position within its list

url.description: The card's page — the link to give a human

operations.description: Create a card at the bottom of a list. The card is created unassigned, with no due date and no labels; Trello notifies whoever watches the list

params.description: The list to create the card in, from trello-board-lists. The only field Trello requires
params.name: list_id

params.description: The card's title, as it will read on the board. Trello permits a card with no name and renders it blank, so pass one
params.name: name

params.description: The card's description, as Markdown. Trello renders it on the card's back
params.name: description

badges.description: Counts Trello renders on the card front. Left untyped rather than enumerated in full

closed.description: Whether the card is archived; false on a card just created

id.description: The created card's id — what trello-card-archive addresses it by afterwards

idList.description: The list the card was created in

idShort.description: The card's per-board number, as shown in its UI

pos.description: The card's sort position within its list

url.description: The card's page — the link to give a human

operations.description: Archive a card, or restore an archived one. Archiving is reversible and destroys nothing: the card leaves its list and stays readable in the board's archive

params.description: The card's id, from trello-list-cards or from trello-card-create's response
params.name: id

params.description: true archives the card; false restores it to the list it was archived from
params.name: closed

badges.description: Counts Trello renders on the card front. Left untyped rather than enumerated in full

closed.description: The card's archived state after this call — echo it back to confirm the change landed

idList.description: The list the card belongs to. An archived card keeps it, which is how a restore knows where to put it back

url.description: The card's page — the link to give a human
